gloss: trade name; business name; firm name

definitions.gloss: trade name; business name; firm name
definitions.explanation: The official name under which a business or company operates. A legal term used in commercial registration and business law.

examples.japanese: {商号|しょうごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}した→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
{商号|しょうごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{届|とど}け{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A formal filing is required to change the business name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{同一|どういつ}→同一：01759_douitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{商号|しょうごう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In some cases, the same business name cannot be used in the same area.

notes:
A legal and business term for the official name under which a company or individual conducts business. In Japanese commercial law, the {商号|しょうごう} is registered with the Legal Affairs Bureau ({法務局|ほうむきょく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商号|しょうごう}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: trade name registration
- {商号|しょうごう}{変更|へんこう}: change of business name
- {商号|しょうごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use a trade name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社名|しゃめい}: company name — more common in everyday use
- ⟦{屋号|やごう}→屋号：12527_yagou⟧: shop name, house name — used for smaller businesses, traditional shops, and traditional family names
- ⟦{商標|しょうひょう}→商標：12019_shouhyou⟧: trademark — a different concept; protects brands and logos rather than business names

REGISTER:
Formal/legal. In everyday conversation, {社名|しゃめい} or ⟦{会社名|かいしゃめい}→会社名：26206_kaishamei⟧ is more natural.
